title: Basketball Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Basketball Scoreboard plugin - displays live, recent, and upcoming NBA, WNBA, NCAA Men's, and NCAA Women's basketball games

scroll_card.title: Scroll & Vegas Card Layout
scroll_card.description: Layout of the game cards built for scroll and Vegas modes. The full-screen scoreboard is drawn separately and is not affected by these settings.

upcoming_center.title: Middle of an Upcoming Card
upcoming_center.description: What to show between the two logos before a game starts. Upcoming games never show a score, since the game has not been played.

vs_text.title: Matchup Separator
vs_text.description: Text drawn between the two teams, e.g. VS, @, at, v. The away team is always on the left and the home team on the right, so "at" and "@" read correctly as "away at home". Leave blank to draw nothing.

date_format.title: Date Format
date_format.description: How to write the date: abbrev "Sep 19", numeric "9/19", day_first "19 Sep", numeric_day_first "19/9", weekday "Fri Sep 19".

show_date.title: Show Date
show_date.description: Draw the date on upcoming cards.

show_time.title: Show Time
show_time.description: Draw the start time on upcoming cards.

swap_date_time.title: Swap Date and Time
swap_date_time.description: Put the date on top and the time along the bottom instead of the default.

center_gap.title: Center Gap
center_gap.description: Pixels kept clear down the middle so the score or VS is not drawn over the team logos. Leave unset to scale with the card width. 0 restores the old edge-to-edge logos.

center_gap_ratio.title: Center Gap Ratio
center_gap_ratio.description: Fraction of card width used for the centre gap when it is not pinned.

center_gap_min.title: Center Gap Minimum
center_gap_min.description: Lower bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

center_gap_max.title: Center Gap Maximum
center_gap_max.description: Upper bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the basketball scoreboard plugin

display_duration.description: Duration in seconds for the display controller to show this plugin mode before rotating to next plugin

update_interval.description: How often to fetch new data in seconds

game_display_duration.description: Duration in seconds to show each individual game before rotating to the next game within the same mode

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to display event start times (e.g. America/Chicago). Leave blank to follow the LEDMatrix global timezone, or the system timezone if none is set.

background_service.title: Background Service Settings
background_service.description: Configuration for background data fetching service

request_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds for API calls

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed requests

enabled.description: Enable NBA games

exclude_teams.description: Team abbreviations to always hide from live rotation and recent/final scores (e.g. to avoid spoilers when watching delayed). Takes priority over favorite_teams and show_all_live.

display_modes.title: Display Modes
display_modes.description: Control which game types to show

live_display_mode.description: Display mode for live games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

recent_display_mode.description: Display mode for recent games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

upcoming_display_mode.description: Display mode for upcoming games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

scroll_settings.title: Scroll Settings
scroll_settings.description: Settings for scroll display mode (when display mode is set to 'scroll')

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second (default: 50). Higher values scroll faster.

scroll_delay.description: Delay between scroll frames in seconds (default: 0.01 = 100 FPS). Lower values = smoother scrolling.

gap_between_games.description: Gap in pixels between game cards when scrolling

show_league_separators.description: Show league icons between different leagues

dynamic_duration.description: Automatically calculate display duration based on content width

game_card_width.description: Width of each game card in scroll mode (pixels). Default 128. Set lower on multi-panel chains to show more games simultaneously.

live_priority.description: Give live games priority over other modes. When enabled, live games will interrupt the normal mode rotation and be displayed immediately when available.

live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds to display each live game before rotating to the next. When a separate non-favorite duration is set, this applies to games with a favorite team; it applies to ALL live games when no favorite teams are configured.

non_favorite_live_game_duration.description: Duration in seconds for live games that do NOT involve a favorite team. Only applies when favorite teams are set AND non-favorite live games are shown ('show_favorite_teams_only' off, or 'show_all_live' on). 0 (default) = use live_game_duration for every live game (no change).

live_update_interval.description: How often to update live game data (seconds)

update_interval_seconds.description: How often to fetch new data (seconds)

game_limits.title: Game Limits
game_limits.description: Control how many games to show

recent_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

upcoming_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

other_upcoming_games_to_show.title: Other upcoming games to show
other_upcoming_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite upcoming games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Your favorites are shown first, then this many other games. Set to 0 to show only your favorites. Ignored when 'Show favorite teams only' is on, or when no favorite teams are set.

other_recent_games_to_show.title: Other recent games to show
other_recent_games_to_show.description: How many NON-favorite recent games to include when favorite teams are set but 'Show favorite teams only' is off. Set to 0 to show only your favorites.

other_rotation_interval_seconds.title: Rotate other games every (seconds)
other_rotation_interval_seconds.description: How often (seconds) to advance the window of NON-favorite games, so the board works through the schedule over time instead of showing the same handful. Variety comes from this turnover rather than from a larger selection: a bigger selection makes a full cycle longer, which makes any given game appear less often. Set to 0 to keep a fixed selection. Only applies when favorite teams are set and 'Show favorite teams only' is off.

show_favorite_teams_only.description: Only show games from favorite teams

show_all_live.description: Show all live games, not just favorites

favorite_live_boost.description: How many turns your favorite team's live game gets in the rotation for every 1 turn other live games get. Your favorite's game is also always queued first whenever the live rotation refreshes. Set to 1 for even rotation.

display_durations.description: How long to display games on screen (in seconds)

base.description: Base display duration for NBA games

live.description: Display duration for live NBA games

recent.description: Display duration for recent NBA games

upcoming.description: Display duration for upcoming NBA games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NBA games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NBA live games

max_duration_seconds.description: Max duration for NBA recent games

mode_durations.title: Mode-Level Durations
mode_durations.description: Control total duration for each mode type for NBA. If not set, uses dynamic calculation (total_games × per_game_duration).

recent_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Recent mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (uses dynamic calculation). Set to null to use dynamic calculation. When mode cycles back, continues from last game shown (no repetition).

upcoming_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Upcoming mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (uses dynamic calculation). Set to null to use dynamic calculation. When mode cycles back, continues from last game shown (no repetition).

schedule_lookback_days.description: How far back to fetch games for the Recent screen. Raise it if finished games disappear sooner than you want.

schedule_lookahead_days.title: Schedule lookahead (days)
schedule_lookahead_days.description: How far ahead to fetch games for the Upcoming screen. Raise it for a league that plays weekly: a fixture just beyond this horizon is not fetched at all, so it never reaches the board even though the date is known.

no_data_interval_seconds.title: Idle live-check interval (seconds)
no_data_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait between checks for live games when there are none. Backs off further the longer nothing is found, up to the cap below.

live_idle_max_interval_seconds.title: Maximum idle live-check interval (seconds)
live_idle_max_interval_seconds.description: Ceiling for the back-off above. Raise it to poll an out-of-season league even less; lower it to notice the first game after a quiet spell sooner.
